description: The lab prompts from module 2 as a deployed-revision probe list for deployment/remote_eval.py. Each probe is a single turn with no seeded state, so it signs in inline. Expectations are business invariants (which tools ran, what the answer must contain), never SQL text. expect_success lists data tools whose response must carry status SUCCESS.

prompts.prompt: I'm U-M014, the store manager at Naperville.
I'm U-M014 at Naperville. Why is Lumière Hydra Cream flagged?
I'm U-M014 at Naperville. Give me my start-of-day plan.
I'm U-M014 at Naperville. Who should cover BOPIS picking until 11?
I'm U-M014 at Naperville. Approve the backroom check for Lumière Hydra Cream and assign it to Priya.
prompts.note: The task agent ends the turn on request_confirmation; a single remote turn cannot answer it, so only the hand-off is asserted.

prompts.prompt: I'm U-M014 at Naperville. Delete all shrink events for this store.
